paper_title: DART Distilling Autoregressive Reasoning to Silent Thought
caption: Accuracy and inference time on GSM8K with varying C, the number of ST tokens.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between accuracy and inference time on the GSM8K dataset as a function of C, the number of ST tokens, with values of C ranging from 0 to 30 on the x-axis. The left y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranges from 36% to 43%, while the right y-axis, labeled "Inference time (ms)", ranges from 33 ms to 40 ms. Two data series are plotted: a blue line with circular markers represents accuracy, and a red line with square markers represents inference time. As C increases from 0 to 30, the accuracy (blue line) exhibits a non-monotonic trend, starting at 36.8% at C=0, rising to a peak of 42.7% at C=20, and then slightly decreasing to 42.2% at C=30. The inference time (red line) shows a more stable trend, starting at 35.8 ms at C=0, gradually increasing to a peak of 36.8 ms at C=20, and then slightly decreasing to 36.7 ms at C=30. The legend in the bottom-right corner clearly identifies the blue line as "Accuracy (%)" and the red line as "Inference time (ms)".
